|game_text=Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when 'thrown.' During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Whenever you play [[Desperate Tactics]], [[Lucky Shot (V){{!}}Lucky Shot]], [[On Target]], [[Rapid Fire]], or [[Steady Aim]], may draw top card from Reserve Deck. May not be suspended. (Immune to [[Alter]].)
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E2 of [[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time]] (version 3 of 4). The image here is the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-maneuveringflaps&nickoftime-pre.gif]]). The current text is [[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source; differences that come only from a document's medium (icons written out in words on the card list, straight quotes, credit lines) are not changes.
* '''Original''' ([[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time]]): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when ‘thrown.’ During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Whenever you play Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, On Target, Rapid Fire, or Steady Aim, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. May not be suspended. [Immune to Alter]”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=11 Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010), page 11, slip 81. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf#page=11 Internet Archive]</ref> The release-sheet slip prints the slip number “81” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 12 December 2012) removed “May not be suspended.” (the card list writes the ▲ and Immune to Alter icons out in words): “Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when 'thrown.' During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to take its matching pilot character (or vice versa) from Reserve Deck and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle. Whenever you play Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, On Target, Rapid Fire, or Steady Aim, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. (Immune to Alter.)”.<ref name="cl-1261_82-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list is a text page: no slip, picture or slip number, and icons are written out in words.
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-maneuveringflaps&nickoftime-pre.gif]]) prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when 'thrown.' During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Whenever you play Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, On Target, Rapid Fire, or Steady Aim, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. May not be suspended. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' “May not be suspended.” returns, and the slip again prints “▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously” for the card list's written-out “take its matching pilot character (or vice versa) from Reserve Deck and deploy both simultaneously; reshuffle”. The image is undated. The PC's image folder (Virtual6-Light) lists the file, with every other file in it, as last modified on 25 February 2013<ref name="r6-Virtual6-Light">[https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A Apache directory listing of Virtual6-Light/large] (Internet Archive, captured 18 August 2019): every file in the folder last modified 25 February 2013; the captures of the image in 2018 and 2019 have the same bytes as the file on the wiki. Research note R6, 11 November 2026.</ref>; it is dated by that upload date, after the card list and before the Master List. The date is a bulk upload of the whole folder, so the image may have been made earlier, but the wiki orders versions by the date each document was published (Bill, 11 November 2026). It is a version of its own even though its words repeat an earlier text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version). The card image is the whole card, with the Decipher picture, and prints the slip number “81” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[Maneuvering Flaps & •Nick Of Time (Errata 3)]]): The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 26)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26, page 26. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=26 Internet Archive]</ref> prints the original printed text again, word for word: “Deploy on table. Your vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when 'thrown.' During your deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Whenever you play Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, On Target, Rapid Fire, or Steady Aim, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. May not be suspended. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' Nothing in the words: the Master List prints the same words as the card image. The Master List repeats words published earlier; it is a version of its own because it was published after a different text (Bill, 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat). As the latest publication it is the current text. The PC website card list was generated from the Holotable card data; the Master List went back to the release-sheet words. The Master List slip shows the whole card frame with the picture area left blank; it prints no slip number at bottom right (the release-sheet slip has “81”). GEMP's current card plays this text: the Effect may not be suspended (play change from the card-list text, approved by Bill, 11 November 2026).
